analysis_type: Post-hoc saved-trace arithmetic; no new native calls or model selection.

figure_revision.reason: First actual-world tick label clipped; moved annotation inside axes and clarified model-weight/value wording.

frontier_measurement: Conditional on forcing the named root action, with saved chance and continuation policies. Excludes root-action probability; not a time-allocation or unconditional-policy statistic.

geometry_review.scope: Independent queen line scan on board64 after d1d5; current enemy visibility agrees with complete native replies already checked by417. No inference of full opponent knowledge.

limitations: Same saved tree and both continuation policies throughout; no new native engine, replay, sample, model, fit or game.
Values are approximate solver utilities, not calibrated win probabilities, Elo or definitive true-position values.
Local one-decision deviation gap is not exploitability/Nash convergence or a global best response.
Frozen-value sensitivity changes hypothetical chance weights or expected values analytically; an actual re-solve changes continuations and can behave differently.
Frontier counts describe exported first two plies only. They do not prove an evaluation error, inferior compute allocation or the outcome of extra search.
No new raw data, GPU, candidate ZIP/version, production source/default/service or website deployment.
